description:
Ask a human to approve (or deny) an action. Returns approve_url for them: they read the request and sign with their
wallet (free, no transaction). Your agent then calls approval_wait, or watches your live channel for approval.approved.
Only the named wallet can decide; your API key can only cancel. Requires the organization API key.

action.description: Plain-English action the human is approving, e.g. 'Wire 4,800 USDC to Acme for invoice 1042'
action.title: Action

approver_wallet.description: 0x wallet of the human who decides (if no mandate_id)
approver_wallet.title: Approver Wallet

payee.description: Payee address or domain, if money is involved
payee.title: Payee

reason.description: Why the agent wants to do this
reason.title: Reason

name: approval_request
title: Approvals: ask a human
